description_en: A narrow fainting couch with one high end, a low partial back and an open foot end; the front shows the asymmetric upholstered seat and woven apron, the side reveals the high curled headrest, and the rear exposes the stepped back frame and bound horizontal rails. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A narrow fainting couch with one high end, a low partial back and an open foot end; the front shows the asymmetric upholstered seat and woven apron, the side reveals the high curled headrest, and the rear exposes the stepped back frame and bound horizontal rails. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. CRITICAL CAMERA AND DESIGN CORRECTION: The canonical front is the LONG OPEN SEATING FACE of this fainting couch, with the tall curled head at image left and open foot end at image right. Orbit EXACTLY 90 degrees toward the OBJECT'S RIGHT END (the low open foot end), and photograph the narrow END ELEVATION, looking along the couch length. The full long side must collapse to a narrow depth view; do not show a long broad couch silhouette and do not flip the front. The low foot rail is foreground and the tall curled head lies far behind, with the asymmetric rear back rail receding away. Preserve exact red finish, open hex weave, one long white cushion, four legs and all frame geometry.
